A '''mediscan unit''' was a medical unit installed aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Although it was less capable than a sickbay, it was capable of diagnosing and treating injuries including [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] burns and deep flesh wounds.
